column4: Continue the first reference: identical locked camera, window, wall and gloved hand. The scissors blades have now snapped SHUT. The lock of hair has been cut: a short stub of orange hair remains hanging from the window frame, and the severed piece of hair is falling below the scissors, still in a loose bundle, slightly tilted. Nothing else changes, no text.

Extreme close-up of the doll's face, left-center of the frame, in profile turned slightly toward the right, eyes peacefully CLOSED, her cheek resting against a single thin taut straight vertical string of tan gold (#A68957) that runs from the top edge to the bottom edge of the frame at about 60 percent of the width. Same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, ruffled white maid headband, ball joints. Her long orange hair falls behind her. The background is flat coal black (#211815), nothing else. No text.
